say:0:1221109001:0.text: So all the rainbow snapper have gone to that island. No wonder there's none here.
say:0:1221109001:0.source_cn: 原来幻彩鲷都游去西北边的小岛上了，难怪这里看不到。

say:1:1221109002:0.text: Magister, let's head over there and try again!
say:1:1221109002:0.source_cn: 主人，我们去那边再试试看吧！
